newsitem.title: INDIA: ABB shifs to emerging markets, local talent.
newsitem.headline: ABB shifs to emerging markets, local talent.

text.p: The chairman of Swiss power equipment maker ABB AG said on Monday the group was shifting in a big way to emerging markets where the focus would be on using local talent.

"It is a huge move from West to East, from North to South," Parcy Barnevik said, commenting on the growing importance of emerging markets as part of ABB's shift away from its traditional base in Europe.
Speaking in New Delhi about ABB's experiences in east Europe, Barnevik said ABB's expansion in the future would not rely so much on applying more capital as on other issues.
"What they need is not primarily capital," Barnevik said, adding that emerging markets needed to improve management, methods and market orientation to increase labour productivity.
"You mix modern technology with low wages," Barnevik said.
Barnevik said India was the future export engine in Asia.
